title: Add a function
prompt: Add slugify(text) to text_utils.py. It returns a lowercase version for use in web addresses: accents are removed (é becomes e), every run of characters that aren't letters or digits becomes a single hyphen, and there are no hyphens at the start or end. For example slugify('  Héllo, World!  ') == 'hello-world'. Keep the existing functions as they are.
